column3: “Final” renders ἐσχάτας (“last”); “is completed” renders the aorist “was completed.”
BSB follows the critical text with no “and over its mark.” “Beside which stood” renders “standing upon the sea”; “from God” renders “of God.”
BSB follows the critical text with “King of the nations” (the Textus Receptus has “of the saints”). “God’s servant Moses” recasts “Moses the servant of God.”
BSB follows the critical text with no “behold.” “The temple—the tabernacle of the Testimony” recasts “the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony.”
